searchText: hey guys! I have some questions related to Ethereum improvement proposals. Do you have a weekly call to answer questions? How does the approval process work? Can you Dm for guy There is an EIP Editing office hours https://github.com/ethereum-cat-herders/EIPIP/issues/234 Yes, for EIP 18 #234 editing file. This proposal has already been accepted and now they are discussing improvements, is that it? Because I haven't sent my proposal yet, but I would like to participate in the call, is that possible? Suggest adding your questions (at least a high level overview) as a comment to the issue so they can be added to the agenda. The issue linked there isn't an EIP itself, but an agenda for our biweekly call for authors to connect with editors and ask questions. We'd love it if you came out on <t:1685458800:f> if you have any questions about the process!
